id.appPath: src/data/tutor/live-manual.ts binds the uploaded drawing or photo
id.mcpPath: Used by the tutor_attachment read with an active grant
id.exportPolicy: Included with the owner's image backup
id.deletionPolicy: Removed with the turn or owner

user_id.appPath: Bound by the authenticated tutor command
user_id.exportPolicy: Included in the authenticated owner snapshot
user_id.deletionPolicy: Removed with the turn or owner

turn_id.appPath: Bound with the learner turn in the tutor command
turn_id.mcpPath: Used to verify attachment access against the granted turn
turn_id.exportPolicy: Included in the authenticated owner snapshot
turn_id.deletionPolicy: Removed with the turn or owner

position.appPath: Determines the image order in the learner turn
position.mcpPath: Determines the order of image content blocks
position.exportPolicy: Included in the authenticated owner snapshot
position.deletionPolicy: Removed with the turn or owner

kind.appPath: Determines the drawing or photo label in the transcript
kind.mcpPath: Describes the image type in the turn
kind.exportPolicy: Included in the authenticated owner snapshot
kind.deletionPolicy: Removed with the turn or owner

mime_type.appPath: Collected from the bounded upload before binding
mime_type.mcpPath: Validated against the image content block
mime_type.exportPolicy: Included in the authenticated owner snapshot
mime_type.deletionPolicy: Removed with the turn or owner

byte_size.appPath: Read from the bounded upload before binding
byte_size.mcpPath: Validated before returning the image content block
byte_size.exportPolicy: Included in the authenticated owner snapshot
byte_size.deletionPolicy: Removed with the turn or owner
